newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai wins $50 mln Turkey train order.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai wins $50 mln Turkey train order.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Precision and Industries and ABB Daimler-Benz Transportation (Adtranz) have won a $50 million order from Turkey's southern city of Adana to provide light trains, Hyundai said on Monday.

In a statement, the company said Hyundai Precision, a unit of the Hyundai Group, would make the trains, while the Swedish parrent would be in charge of railway construction, communications and electric parts.
Adtranz is a joint venture between Swiss-Swedish group ABB ASEA Brown Boveri AG and Daimler-Benz AG. The trains are scheduled to be delivered by the end of 1998, it said.
